text: This is a tennis court you absolutely must visit if you enjoy playing tennis. It's located right in Hua Hin town, and the facilities are excellent. There's one court, showers, rackets available to borrow, and balls ready to play with. Coach Music is amazing; he sends out such positive energy. We played at 7 am and received so much positive vibes. The coach is very dedicated and corrects every problem we struggled with. I hope the court is fully booked all day!

The tennis courts are excellent! The owner is very kind and friendly. They gave us a whole basket of new balls to hit with for free – we played until we were exhausted! If you don't have a racket, they have rackets you can borrow; just leave them there. I'll definitely be back to play again.

Great tennis courts! Very new, clean, and well-maintained. Perfect place to play and enjoy a good game!
The field is good, the equipment is complete, and the staff respond quickly. Excellent!

The court was great.

The indoor court is 400 baht per hour. It's very private and fully equipped. I'll definitely come back again when I have the chance. 😊 …

The indoor tennis court is a 10/10. It's fully equipped with rackets and tennis balls. The restrooms are clean and have showers, making it perfect for exercise. If you're a beginner or want to learn tennis, the court offers coaches. They also have coaching sessions available; just inquire. The prices are reasonable, and the coaches are excellent and easy to understand. Highly recommended!
Lovely Tennis court with covered and super helpful people here!

An excellent tennis court with rackets to choose from and a whole box of balls. There's a cage around it, so the balls don't fly away.
You can also buy water or isotonic drinks there. There are restrooms and showers. The lighting works in the evening, but I wish it were brighter; it seems to be lacking. I've attached the owner's contact information in the photo. We had a great time playing for a couple of hours; we arrived without a reservation, and the court was available.
High-quality surface, great coaches and the most wonderful owner. This is the go-to tennis club in Hua Hin!

We were driving by and saw a court that just became available, so we rented it for an hour. It cost 400 baht, rackets and balls are free, and drinks are included. We had a great time! It's convenient that it's completely covered, so you don't have to worry about your balls.
